title: REQ · App closes the ActionMenu on menuClose and keeps it open on selection
description: Context: App.tsx stores selectedId and sets it on objectClick (L58). Desired: a menuClose event clears selectedId so the ActionMenu unmounts, and the subscription is released on unmount.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected object with the ActionMenu shown, when menuClose is emitted, then the ActionMenu is removed.
Given unmount, then the menuClose handler is unsubscribed.
technical_constraints: Use useEffect returning the unsubscribe from phaserToReact.on
